name: Izimpawu eziyingozi zokukhulelwa
tagline: Ukopha, ubuhlungu obukhulu, akukho mnyakazo - ukuthi ungene nini.
sources: South African Society of Obstetricians and Gynaecologists

urgent.heading: Hamba esibhedlela manje uma
urgent.primary_message: Izimpawu eziyingozi zokukhulelwa zingasho umehluko phakathi kokuphila nokufa - kumama noma enganeni. Ungalindi. Ungaqageli okwesibili. Hamba.
red_flags: Ukopha kakhulu esithweni sangasese - ngaphezu kwesikhathi esivamile
Ubuhlungu obukhulu besisu noma beqolo obungeke budambe
Ikhanda elibuhlungu elibuhlungu nokungaboni kahle noma amabala okubona
Ukuvuvukala okungazelelwe kobuso, izandla, noma izinyawo

what_is_it.heading: Kungani lokhu kubalulekile
what_is_it.lede: Ukukhulelwa ngokuvamile kuphephile eNingizimu Afrika, kodwa ukushona komama kusavame kakhulu - futhi okuningi kuyagwemeka. Ukwazi izimpawu zengozi nokwenza ngokushesha kusindisa izimpilo.
paragraphs: INingizimu Afrika iqopha ukufa komama abangaphezu kwe-1,000 minyaka yonke. Umbiko weSaving Mothers ubonisa ukuthi okuningi kwenzeka ngenxa yezizathu ezingagwemeka - ukopha, umfutho wegazi ophakeme, ukutheleleka, izinkinga zezimo ezivele zikhona. Ukufa okuningi kwenzeka ngoba izimpawu zokuxwayisa zachithwa noma ukunakekelwa kubambezelekile.

Awudingi ukwazi ukuthi yini engalungile. Udinga nje ukubona ukuthi kukhona okungahambi kahle, bese ufika esibhedlela. Ukunakekelwa kwamahhala kokubelethisa kuyatholakala kuzo zonke izibhedlela zikahulumeni. Themba umuzwa wakho wemvelo - uma okuthile kuzwakala kungalungile, mhlawumbe kunjalo.

items.body: Abesifazane baseNingizimu Afrika bashona bekhulelwe noma bebeletha minyaka yonke. Iningi lalokhu kufa liyagwemeka.

items.headline: I-MomConnect
items.body: Ukusekelwa kwamahhala kwe-WhatsApp yokukhulelwa okuvela ku-NDoH kuzo zonke izilimi zaseNingizimu Afrika. Thumela u-'Hi' ku-079 631 2456 ukuze ubhalise.

items.headline: Ukunakekelwa kwamahhala
items.body: Konke ukuvakasha kwabakhulelwe, ukubeletha, nokunakekelwa okuphuthumayo kokubelethisa kumahhala kuzo zonke izibhedlela zikahulumeni nemitholampilo.

items.headline: Zithembe
items.body: Uma kukhona okungahambi kahle, ngena. Abasebenzi bezempilo bancamela ukukubona ngeze kunokuphuthelwa okuthile okungathi sína.

pull_quote.text: Konke ukushona komama kunendaba ngemuva kwakho yezimpawu eziyisixwayiso ezigejiwe noma ezichithiwe. Uma ukhulelwe futhi ukhathazekile, impendulo efanele ihlale ihlolwe. Njalo.

signs.heading: Izimpawu eziyisixwayiso ngesigaba sokukhulelwa
signs.lede: Ezinye izimpawu zibalulekile kunoma yisiphi isigaba. Ezinye zibaluleke kakhulu ngezikhathi ezithile. Lapho ungabaza - hlola.

items.title: Amasonto angu-12 okuqala
items.description: Ukopha kakhulu, ubuhlungu obukhulu ohlangothini olulodwa (kungaba ectopic pregnancy — esongela ukuphila), ukuhlanza okunzima okuvimbela ukugcina uketshezi luphansi, imfiva engaphezu kuka-38°C.

items.title: Ngemva kwamaviki angu-12
items.description: Ukopha kakhulu, ikhanda elibuhlungu elibuhlungu nokushintsha kokubona (okungenzeka i-pre-eclampsia), ukuvuvukala okukhulu, ukunyakaza kwengane kuhamba kancane noma ukuma (emva kwamasonto angama-28).

items.title: Eduze noma ngesikhathi (ngemuva kwamaviki angama-37)
items.description: Ukufinyela okuvamile, ukuphuka kwamanzi, ukopha, ukuncipha kokunyakaza kwengane, ikhanda elibuhlungu elibuhlungu noma ubuhlungu besisu. Ungazami ukubeka isikhathi izinto ekhaya - ngena.

items.title: Uma kuvela uphawu lwengozi - yiya esibhedlela
items.description: Ungazishayeli wena uma ungakwazi ukukugwema. Shayela i-ambulensi noma othile akushayele. Thatha ikhadi lakho labakhulelwe noma incwadi yasemtholampilo.

items.title: Ungazami ukubeka isikhathi izimpawu ekhaya
items.description: Ubuhlungu obukhulu, ukopha, noma izinguquko zokubona azidingi isikhathi. Ngena. I-Pre-eclampsia nokukhulelwa kwe-ectopic kungabulala emahoreni ambalwa.

items.title: Yiya esibhedlela osibhukhile noma esiseduze
items.description: Izibhedlela zikahulumeni kufanele zamukele izimo eziphuthumayo ezikhulelwe kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubhukhe kuphi. Thatha amarekhodi akho uma unawo.

items.title: Uma ungaqiniseki — thumela umyalezo ku-MomConnect
items.description: Usizo lwamahhala lwe-WhatsApp — thumela u-'Hi' ku-079 631 2456. Umtholampilo wakho ungakucebisa ukuthi ungene yini. Uma ungaqiniseki, khetha isibhedlela.

items.title: Yiya kuzo zonke izikhathi zokuvakasha kwabakhulelwe
items.description: Izimpawu eziningi zengozi zibanjwa kusenesikhathi ekuvakasheni kokubeletha okujwayelekile. Kumahhala kuyo yonke imitholampilo. Uhlelo luvimbela izimo eziphuthumayo.

get_help.heading: Lapho okumele uye khona
get_help.lede: Izimo eziphuthumayo zokukhulelwa zidinga isibhedlela, hhayi umtholampilo. Iya esibhedlela sikahulumeni esinamasevisi okubelethisa - Tygerberg, Charlotte Maxeke, Steve Biko, King Edward, nabanye ezweni lonke.
